name: coopanion-connector-dsh
description: Bridge between the Coopanion desktop pet (cortico-world-fatfish) and DeepSeek Harness: one loopback WebSocket where DSH reports its turns, approvals and replies, and accepts the pet's words into the conversation that owns it. v0.2.16 ships the rebuilt dist/index.cjs: 0.2.14 fixed apply() dying on cordis' service guard in source only, so 0.2.14 and 0.2.15 packages failed to activate on load with 'cannot get property webServer without inject' and /coopanion/status 404 (issues #11 and #12). v0.2.15 stops the upgrade route from being re-claimed every 5s on a Host that stores route copies (issue #8). v0.2.14 lets the pet name the workspace a new conversation lands in (PR #9) and fixes apply() dying on cordis' service guard (issue #9). v0.2.9 fixed CSWSH (issue #6).
author: Pal AI Lab
